description: This file defines the core Browser class and related interfaces for managing browser instances, contexts, downloads, videos, and process control within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Abstract class representing a browser instance, providing methods for context management, downloads, videos, and lifecycle control.

methods.name: doCreateNewContext
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new browser context with specified options.

methods.name: contexts
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve all active browser contexts.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the browser is currently connected.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Abstract method to get the browser version.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Abstract method to get the user agent string.

methods.name: sdkLanguage
methods.description: Returns the SDK language used by the browser instance.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with validation and optional proxy setup.

methods.name: newContextForReuse
methods.description: Reuses or creates a new context based on provided parameters for efficiency.

methods.name: contextForReuse
methods.description: Returns the current context set for reuse.

methods.name: _downloadCreated
methods.description: Tracks a new download associated with a page.

methods.name: _downloadFilenameSuggested
methods.description: Updates the filename suggestion for an ongoing download.

methods.name: _downloadFinished
methods.description: Marks a download as finished and reports its status.

methods.name: _videoStarted
methods.description: Associates a video artifact with a page and context when video recording starts.

methods.name: _takeVideo
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a video artifact by ID.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the browser is closed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser, optionally with a reason, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: killForTests
methods.description: Kills the browser process for testing purposes.
